statement: The sampled plots contained a median of seven recorded species.
review_reason: Summarises observations already present in the defined sample.

statement: Estimate field-measured vegetation height for plots withheld from model development.
review_reason: Names an unknown target for new cases and requires independent predictive evaluation.

statement: Vegetation height was associated with the UAV structural metric after accounting for declared site effects.
review_reason: Describes a modelled relationship without claiming an intervention effect.

statement: Increasing grazing intensity would reduce vegetation height compared with unchanged management.
review_reason: Asks about the outcome under an intervention and comparison condition.

statement: Map the field measurements at their sampled plot locations.
review_reason: Mapping observed values does not itself estimate targets for unseen cases.

statement: Classify unsurveyed 10 m cells into the three predeclared habitat-condition classes.
review_reason: Assigns a target class to prediction units without supplied labels.

statement: Examine whether texture contains information about the target within the represented sites.
review_reason: Investigates a relationship; the wording does not yet make a new-case performance claim.

statement: The fitted model proves NDVI is the ecological mechanism controlling biomass.
review_reason: Uses mechanism language that ordinary predictive modelling cannot establish.

statement: Predict next-year condition from features available before the annual decision date.
review_reason: Names future cases and an operational feature-availability boundary.

statement: Recorded target missingness differed among the sampled sites.
review_reason: Reports a property of the observed table.

statement: Removing reed cover would improve the management score.
review_reason: Describes an intervention effect rather than an association or prediction.

statement: Characterise how residual variation changes along the salinity proxy gradient.
review_reason: Seeks structure in a relationship and model failure rather than an intervention effect.
